title: Seat exit reminder gates on session duration, not on whether the session changed anything
description:
The Stop-hook handoff reminder landed by eshyra-oqvj (PR #560, merge 46048f55) fires only once a session has run at least EXIT_REMINDER_MIN_SESSION_MS = 45 minutes (scripts/seats/seatContext.mjs:215, consumed by handoffExitReminder at :344).

OBSERVED MISS, first session after the mechanism landed:

Session ad735081-d4a7-412a-bbc1-61c9a5dbed4b ran 2026-09-22T05:05:55.760Z to 05:23:37.415Z -- 17m42s -- in /home/jhbongaarts/src/eshyra on CLI 2.1.278. It merged PR #561 (eshyra-5wbx, merge commit e7bb1836) and ended. The Stop hook ran at each turn end and correctly emitted nothing: handoffExitReminder returns null below the floor. The handoff was left at its 2026-09-10 state and was still stale when the next session opened.

The entry-side half worked. That session's SessionStart payload (delivered 05:05:55, from eshyra-8pat / PR #559) carried 'Recorded 287h ago', the 48h stale cue, and the exact 'npm run seat:handoff -- write claude-captain' command. So the mechanism is not missing; the exit trigger's predicate is wrong.

THE DEFECT: session duration is a proxy for 'did this session produce something worth resuming from', and it is the wrong proxy in this repo. A short session that merges a PR is exactly the case that invalidates the existing handoff, and it is the case the floor is structurally guaranteed to miss. Several of the last ten merges are that size.

CANDIDATE PREDICATE: fire when the session changed durable state -- a commit authored on a branch, a merge reaching main, a bead status transition -- rather than when it has burned 45 minutes. Duration may remain as a secondary condition for long sessions that have not yet committed anything, but it must not be the only gate. Whatever replaces it, the reminder must stay silent for a session that genuinely produced nothing, or it becomes noise and gets ignored.

OUT OF SCOPE: the authorization design (SessionStart ledger, agent_id / env-marker / stop_hook_active refusals) is sound and is not reopened here. This changes only the trigger predicate in handoffExitReminder.

EVIDENCE: transcript ~/.claude/projects/-home-jhbongaarts-src-eshyra/ad735081-d4a7-412a-bbc1-61c9a5dbed4b.jsonl. Discovered 2026-09-22 when the handoff was found still stale despite both PRs having landed.
notes:
PR #562 open at head 853417ab: https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/562

Trigger now fires on repository movement (HEAD differs from the commit recorded when SessionStart admitted the session), with EXIT_REMINDER_MIN_SESSION_MS demoted to the fallback for a long session that has not committed anything yet.

DISPOSITIONS against the bead's candidate signals:
- commit/merge reaching the checkout: ADOPTED, as HEAD movement at the hook's cwd.
- bead status transition: EXCLUDED. Detecting one means invoking bd or reading its internals from a hook that runs at every turn end, which fails the cost bar the way the original trigger failed the accuracy bar. A bookkeeping-only session under 45 minutes has little to hand over.
- duration as secondary condition: RETAINED exactly as the bead permitted, never as the only gate.

KNOWN BOUND, deliberate: the observed HEAD is the checkout at the hook's cwd, which is the session's project directory. A supervisor that commits only inside a linked worktree shows no movement in the parent checkout and falls back to elapsed time. Such sessions are long, so the fallback covers them. Recorded in the PR rather than fixed.

Cost: the git call is ordered last, reached only by a session otherwise owed a reminder that has not already passed the fallback. Asserted by 'never reads HEAD when a cheaper condition already decides' with a counting stub.

Verification: npm run verify:worktree clean; 307 files passed / 2 skipped, 5617 tests passed / 3 skipped. Five mutations each confirmed red against the test written for it.

Stays in_progress until #562 merges.
Review F1 (2026-09-22, head 853417ab): local HEAD movement misses a remote gh pr merge with a stationary checkout. Addressed in 6282c008: trigger also fires when the session transcript (Stop payload transcript_path) records a Bash tool call to gh pr merge / git commit / git push. PR #562 awaiting re-review.
PR #562 MERGED 2026-09-22, merge commit 68490fac. Worktree and branch removed.
